content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early 2022, especially when sentiment is positive.", "Sentiment spikes correlate with sharp price reversals, indicating model lag in capturing sentiment-driven volatility.", "Models show mean-reversion bias in 2023, underestimating sustained price increases despite positive sentiment.", "Forecast accuracy drops when sentiment is mixed or negative, suggesting sentiment interaction is critical for calibration.", "Models exhibit overshoot in 2022, particularly after strong sentiment peaks, leading to overcorrection in subsequent days.", "Price divergence from forecasts increases with longer time horizons, suggesting model calibration needs dynamic adjustment.", "Sentiment history should be weighted more heavily in forecasting when historical price volatility is high.", "Forecast bias is more pronounced in low-volume periods, indicating model sensitivity to market liquidity changes."]}
